recognize_zh: 多個黃色箭頭指出的大血小板呈深紫色顆粒狀、直徑約紅血球的三分之一到一半，明顯比周圍一般血小板大；左下有一顆小淋巴球可作大小對照。
features: Multiple large platelets (yellow arrows) about one-third to one-half the diameter of a red cell with dense purple granules
Numerous normal-sized platelets and small platelet clumps between and over red cells
Small mature lymphocyte at lower left serving as a size reference
Red cells normochromic with focal crenation; occasional pale ghost-like cells
No schistocytes or red cell inclusions evident
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normochromic red cells with focal crenation and abundant platelets, including numerous normal-sized forms and small aggregates. Several large platelets (yellow arrows), measuring approximately one-third to one-half of a red cell diameter, are distributed throughout the field. A small mature lymphocyte is present at lower left. Findings demonstrate increased large platelets with an adequate platelet estimate, supporting spurious thrombocytopenia on automated counting.

ddx.dx: Red cell inclusions (e.g. Pappenheimer bodies or parasites) overlying red cells
ddx.vs: True inclusions lie within the red cell outline, whereas these platelets sit between or on top of red cells with their own pale hyalomere.
Stain precipitate forms irregular refractile dark granules of varying size across cells and background, without the organized granulomere/hyalomere structure of a platelet.
These cause large platelets with a truly low count and require leukocyte inclusion review, flow cytometry for GPIb-IX or genetic testing.
